mouth.label: Mouth
mouth.line: Where the run begins. The way up.

fight.label: Fight
fight.line: A floor of creatures. Clear it for a material; fail and take a crack.

genre.label: Trial
genre.line: A floor of another kind of game. Clear it for a material of a tier higher.

spring.label: Spring
spring.line: Mends one crack. With none, your smallest spent die comes back.

hazard.label: Hazard
hazard.line: Throw the fate die. Under its save, take a crack.

shift.label: Shift
shift.line: The Well moves you the spaces it shows.

shop.label: Shop
shop.line: Buy one item with the cubes this run has found.

item.label: Item
item.line: A random item. With your hands full, cubes.

arcana.label: Arcana
arcana.line: Draw a Major Arcana. It does what it says, for good or ill.

door.label: Door
door.line: Stops you. Opens down once two floors here are cleared; shut, it sends you round again. The way up.

foe.label: FOE
foe.line: Stops you. The FOE wakes once two floors here are cleared; asleep, the space sends you round again.
